parsed.name: 通用实验室物理设备
parsed.description: 用于表示可连接到计算机的通用实验室硬件设备，通常可通过 USB 标识进行发现，并支持初始化、命令发送、设备匹配和后台状态监测。该证据未指向具体仪器型号，更像是适用于多类实验设备的通用物理设备抽象。
parsed.description_en: A generic representation of a computer-connected laboratory hardware device, typically discoverable by USB identifiers and supporting initialization, command transfer, device matching, and background status monitoring. The evidence does not indicate a specific instrument model and instead points to a general physical-device abstraction for multiple kinds of lab equipment.
